name: strata-sustained-512
description: Long-answer (512-token) Strata decode on one L40S, to separate sustained decode from the 128-token matrix.

estimate.basis: planning estimate only: no 512-token Strata run has been performed yet

caveats: This recipe is a new definition assembled from the 128-token matrix; it has NOT been run. Do not treat its estimate as measured.
512 completion tokens at 5 requests per slot reduce prefill dominance but increase wall time linearly; keep --budget-min below the 11.5 h Slurm limit.
The engine's draft head and MTP acceptance are most visible at long answers; record acceptance from /metrics if present.
The 4096:4 cell is a batch stress point, not four independent servers.
